title: First Adam is given a helper; Last Adam gives a Helper (Genesis 2:18, John 14:26)
summary: Two columns. First Adam is given a helper: Genesis 2:18, 'It is not good for the man to be alone; I will make him a helper suitable for him.' Last Adam gives a Helper: John 14:26, the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name. The words are colour-coded, with 'Helper' in gold and 'alone' double-underlined.

text.text: 18 Then the LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone; I will make him a helper suitable for him.”
26 "But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said to you.

keywords: it is not good for the man to be alone
